reason: I've never heard of Moduo and I can't find a single G2 or Capterra review, so I'm not moving my whole team and our client history onto it. The client page sounds useful, but $45 a month is cheap compared to the cost of picking a vendor that disappears in a year.
objection: No reviews and no track record. I don't know if this company will exist next year, and the pitch doesn't say whether clients and contractors can get in without each paying for a seat, which is the main thing I need.
would_change_my_mind: A solid set of G2 or Capterra reviews from other small agencies, plus free guest access for clients and contractors.
